title: When the Passage Breaks
author: Edmund Okafor
blurb: Casper Sterling, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
